acceptance: Pickup commits the registry change without stashing work/ (for example git commit --only roadmap/registry.yaml), so a running worker's work/.workers files and other sessions' untracked files under work/ are never moved
If any stash or restore step remains and fails, pickup exits non-zero naming the stash; worker sync reports a gap in a worker's event sequence numbers
Tests run a pickup while another worker's event log is being appended and show no events are lost and no stash entry is left
nodes.title: Pickup never stashes work/ around the registry commit

acceptance: When the roster on the integration ref differs from the working tree or local branch, orchestrate plan and validate print that the roster is read from origin/<integration> and that the local roadmap/orchestration.yaml must be pushed to take effect; with no roster file on the integration ref they say so and point at docs/orchestration.md instead of a may_process hint
Tests cover a local-only roster, a committed-unpushed roster and no roster
nodes.title: orchestrate plan and validate say where the roster is read from

acceptance: A --prefer-agentic flag (and a git-workflow.yaml default) orders ready leaves Agentic-led before Mixed before Human-led within the same tree position; grind-session --plan prints the execution milestone next to the next auto-pick
Tests cover the ordering with and without the flag
nodes.title: Auto-pick can prefer Agentic-led leaves and shows each leaf's mode

acceptance: A git-workflow.yaml nested_repos list names separately versioned repositories under the project root; delegate and pickup create matching worktrees (a feature branch for repos the leaf's touch zones cover, detached otherwise) inside the leaf worktree
worker reconcile diffs the nested repos too, and finish merges the leaf's nested branches; docs describe the layout; tests use a fixture with one nested repo
nodes.title: Worker worktrees can include nested sibling repositories

acceptance: A roster entry can set channels.cli_resume (or an extra_args list appended to both default commands), so worker message and resume keep the same permissions as the launch; a custom cli without a usable resume form is reported at delegate time instead of silently falling back
docs/orchestration-workers.md documents the per-worktree settings-file route for Claude Code permissions; tests cover launch and resume argv
nodes.title: A custom launch command's permissions carry through resume

acceptance: When a worker launches in a linked worktree, the Claude Code adapter adds the main checkout's work/reviews/<ID> directory as an allowed directory (and the equivalent for other harnesses that support it), so the executor can write its READY there

The executor and reviewer clean-tree preconditions name the checkout to run git status in (the leaf worktree path, filled in), so a reviewer does not check the main checkout by mistake; tests cover both prompts and the adapter argv
nodes.title: Executors and reviewers in a worktree can write and check the right places

acceptance: In merge mode, finish-this-task prints before pushing how many commits it will push to the integration branch and how many of them are not from this leaf, and --help says merge mode pushes the integration branch
Tests cover a push that carries an unrelated local commit
nodes.title: finish-this-task says what merge mode will push before it pushes

acceptance: A profile can list aliases (or a roster entry can name its profile), so roster ids like gpt-5.6-sol-high or -xhigh find the GPT-5.6 Sol profile and prompts carry its model notes
Tests cover an alias match and an unmatched id
nodes.title: A model profile can match harness model ids that carry an effort suffix

acceptance: session start --path accepts several paths after one flag (or the error says to repeat --path); prompt --role reviewer accepts --packet or says the packet must be at the default path when review-packet -o wrote elsewhere
worker sync shows the worker's full final message on a completion without READY; session end works on the caller's own stale sessions; the Cursor adapter's default launch passes --trust, with a test
nodes.title: Small CLI fixes from field use

acceptance: specy-road chore start <slug> creates an unregistered work item under work/ (no roadmap node, branch or registry row) that worker delegate, message, sync, usage and review accept in place of a node id, optionally with a roster-free --model and --harness
chore close writes a short record (summary, usage, reviewer verdict); tests cover start, delegate, sync and close
nodes.title: A light chore mode for work outside the roadmap

acceptance: specy-road doctor warns when the running version is older than the version recorded in the AGENTS.md managed block or .specyrd/manifest.json, naming both and the likely cause (an older install earlier on PATH)
Tests cover older, equal and newer
nodes.title: doctor warns when the running specy-road is older than the project's stubs
